fixtureDisclosure: A separate complete genuine Iron Valley save is used as a QA fixture. Completed facilities are copied from genuine native records to validated free, reachable native sites until there are5labs,5vehiclefactories and5cyborgfactories. Only struct.json and the object allocator in gam.json are seeded; game.map, terrain, research, components, power, native limits, rules and queues are retained. Subsequent research/production are real UI actions using ordinary costs/times. This does not claim the extra facilities were constructed normally. The exact complete existing native save is restored before each14profile; no facilities are regenerated. Actual first-profile ordinary unit orders are saved before resetting.
